Product Features

  • With dimensions of 70*40*188 cm, the cabinet has a slim, tall shape that takes up little floor space and is ideal for small apartments.
  • It has two doors – a transparent glass door at the top and a closed wooden door at the bottom – so that presentation and storage are optimally combined.
  • Inside there are 6 storage compartments, including a semi-open level that is perfect for displaying photo albums and decorations.
  • The natural wood color of the back panel combined with the white body creates a warm, cozy atmosphere in the room.
  • The round handles on the doors and the vertical structure of a door provide fine details, easy opening and an appealing look.
  • The raised feet protect the cabinet from moisture and allow for easy cleaning with a robot vacuum cleaner.
  • The height-adjustable shelves inside can be individually adapted to the size of books, collectibles and decorations.
  • The glass door is complemented by LED lighting that can be controlled via a smartphone app to create atmospheric presentation lighting.
  • With a recommended total load capacity of 30 kg, the cabinet is stable and durable, providing safe space for books, decorations and household items.
  • Note: Due to varying shooting conditions and display devices, slight color variations may occur between the actual product and the image. This is normal and not a quality defect. We strive to represent the product color as accurately as possible. Please only order if this is important to you.
